purpose: Wade's standing instruction for his rookie-scale negotiation: the driver submits this counter the day Miami's offer appears, and accepts Miami's agreement to it. The user wrote the structure (October 3, 2026); the driver fills the amounts from the scale.

incentives.label: Offseason skill and conditioning program (10% of scale)

benchmarks.2003-04: Satisfactory attendance and participation in Miami's designated offseason skill and conditioning program (at most two weeks); for 2003-04 Miami provides a post-signing opportunity before camp, with no retroactive credit for summer league.
benchmarks.2004-05: Satisfactory attendance and participation in Miami's designated offseason skill and conditioning program (at most two weeks); for 2003-04 Miami provides a post-signing opportunity before camp, with no retroactive credit for summer league.
benchmarks.2005-06: Satisfactory attendance and participation in Miami's designated offseason skill and conditioning program (at most two weeks); for 2003-04 Miami provides a post-signing opportunity before camp, with no retroactive credit for summer league.

benchmarks.2003-04: Satisfying the Miami preseason conditioning test specified in Exhibit 1 (an objective measurement agreed by the player, Miami and the league).
benchmarks.2004-05: Satisfying the Miami preseason conditioning test specified in Exhibit 1 (an objective measurement agreed by the player, Miami and the league).
benchmarks.2005-06: Satisfying the Miami preseason conditioning test specified in Exhibit 1 (an objective measurement agreed by the player, Miami and the league).

benchmarks.2003-04: Selection to an NBA All-Rookie Team.
benchmarks.2004-05: At least 15.0 points per game while appearing in at least 60 games.
benchmarks.2005-06: At least 17.0 points per game while appearing in at least 60 games.

counter.note: 80% of scale as protected Current Cash Compensation plus up to 40% of scale in CBA-compliant incentives: 20% in physical-condition and designated-program incentives that count as Salary, 20% in objective performance incentives classified by the league (Unlikely for a rookie). Maximum compensation 120% of scale. Miami's stated role is a non-contractual basketball representation. No signing bonus. Three seasons plus the mandatory fourth-year team option at 26.7% over the third season's Salary.

execution: on or after the first legal signing day of the calendar (library/2003/league/nba_2003_04_calendar.json, first_signing_day); the user's source placed it at August 1, which is not supported by the repository's verified 2003 calendar and is not used.
